# ImaginarsClub Services
A senior-led digital studio in Mumbai building websites, mobile apps and AI-driven products.

## Services
- [Services overview](https://www.imaginarsclubservices.com/services)
- Web Development: Fast, findable websites on Next.js
- Mobile App Development: iOS and Android via React Native or Flutter
- AI-Driven Websites: Grounded AI assistants and smart search
- SEO / GEO / AEO: Search, generative engine and answer optimization
- Meta Ad Management: Facebook and Instagram campaigns
- Brand & Content: Video editing, thumbnails, brand systems
